content: xbmcplugin signatures (Kodi master): addDirectoryItem(handle,url,listitem[,isFolder,totalItems])->bool; addDirectoryItems(handle,items[,totalItems])->bool where items is a list of (url,listitem[,isFolder]) tuples - docs state large lists benefit over addDirectoryItem and 'you may call this more than once to add items in chunks'; endOfDirectory(handle[,succeeded,updateListing,cacheToDisc]); setResolvedUrl(handle,succeeded,listitem); setContent(handle,content); addSortMethod(handle,sortMethod[,labelMask,label2Mask]); setPluginCategory(handle,category). handle is the integer the plugin was started with (sys.argv[1]). Playback contract: directory items carry a plugin:// url with property isPlayable=true and isFolder=False; Kodi re-invokes the plugin on that url and the plugin must answer exactly once with setResolvedUrl. A ListItem passed to setResolvedUrl inherits metadata from the directory item, so usually only the path needs setting.
